items.html: And these two brains, in their drawing to enter ZA, before they enter, join in the secret of a coupling. For the drawing of these two brains is the correction of Hochma and Bina; and the correction is their having the form of a man: a head and a body, and arms and legs, and the holy covenant. And this is the matter of 'engraved in truth' — to be engraved in the form of a receptacle of body and soul: the body, a receptacle for the soul, and each one is engraved in its corrections. And Bina, all her corrections entered within ZA, but not so Hochma, for her radiance comes only up to the brain alone, for she is hidden from being attained.
